discovery.title: Single feathers may reveal whether eastern black rails stay in Texas or migrate north
discovery.summary: High-stepping like you're in a marching band while dragging a rope through a wetland at night can make you wonder about your life choices. Several plastic bottles, each filled with two or three noisy cat toys, are attached to the rope. It's pitch black, and all I can hear are the cat toys jingling, the mosquitoes buzzing in my ears and the wetland grasses bouncing in the wind.
